newsitem.title: USA: CinemaStar Luxury names Grossberg COO.
newsitem.headline: CinemaStar Luxury names Grossberg COO.

text.p: CinemaStar Luxury Theaters Tuesday named Chief Financial Officer Alan Grossberg to the new post of senior vice president and chief operating officer.

The company also announced the appointment of Jon Meloan as vice president, general counsel. Meloan previously was secretary and general counsel. Grossberg and Meloan will continue to serve as members of CinemaStar's board of directors.
In addition, the company promoted Katherine McKeever to the post of vice president, advertising and marketing from her previous post as vice president of operations.
McKeever joined CinemaStar in January 1993 as director of marketing and advertising.
